suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy on a Friday afternoon that actually went smooth, no rollback drama.
I'm thankful for the smell of rain hitting hot tar right before Maghrib.
I'm grateful for a staging environment catching the bug before it ever touched prod.
I'm thankful for my mum packing extra rendang in the container without me asking.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a landlord who didn't raise the rent this year.
I'm thankful for the mosque car park having one open spot right when I thought I'd be late for Jumaat.
I'm grateful for a senior engineer who explained the legacy codebase instead of just telling me to figure it out.
I'm thankful for the few quiet minutes scrolling through nothing before Subuh, before the phone starts buzzing with work pings.
I'm grateful for a git merge conflict that resolved itself cleaner than expected.
I'm thankful for the roti canai guy remembering my order without me saying anything.
I'm grateful for a manager who actually said thanks after the incident was resolved at 3am.
I'm thankful for the breeze on the balcony after iftar, full stomach and nowhere to rush to.
I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that failed fast instead of wasting an hour before telling me it broke.
I'm thankful for my little cousin asking me to fix her laptop, an easy win after a week of hard ones.
I'm grateful for the unplanned off day that let me finally go back for my grandparents' open house.
